column1: Access, Correction and Accuracy of Personal Data.Basic Practices

a. Identify data that is often used and relied on, and periodically remind users to view their personal data details and verify that they are correct. For example, this could be done in pop-up windows in apps. Enhanced Practices

b. Provide users with a self-management facility to allow them to self-help and managetheir ownpersonal data. This minimises the possibility of human error as well as reduces employee effort and time.
